hero.label: The Guests
hero.heading: The People Behind the Questions
hero.subheading: Entrepreneurs, artists, scientists, and leaders — each one willing to answer the half question.

guests.name: Maya Chen
guests.title: Founder & Futurist
guests.quote: The companies that last are the ones that know they won't.
guests.bio: Maya Chen has founded three companies, sold two, and is currently building what she calls her 'final act' — a platform rethinking how institutions learn from failure.

guests.name: James Okafor
guests.title: Musician & Activist
guests.quote: Every song is a question the singer doesn't know how to ask out loud.
guests.bio: James Okafor has released seven albums and organized relief efforts across four continents. He believes music and justice are the same conversation.

guests.name: Dr. Priya Nair
guests.title: Neuroscientist
guests.quote: Rest isn't the absence of thought. It's thought at its most honest.
guests.bio: Dr. Priya Nair leads the Cognitive Rest Lab at MIT, studying what happens in the brain during idle states — and why those moments may be the most important of all.

guests.name: Tomás Reyes
guests.title: Architect & Urban Theorist
guests.quote: A city is a sentence that never ends. You just decide where to put the comma.
guests.bio: Tomás Reyes has designed public spaces in 22 cities and written extensively on how architecture shapes political identity.

guests.name: Lena Hoffmann
guests.title: Climate Scientist
guests.quote: Pessimism is a luxury we can't afford. Optimism is a discipline.
guests.bio: Lena Hoffmann is a senior researcher at the Potsdam Institute and one of the lead authors of the 2025 Global Adaptation Report.

guests.name: Kwame Asante
guests.title: Philosopher & Author
guests.quote: Changing your mind isn't weakness. It's the whole point of having one.
guests.bio: Kwame Asante is the author of four books on moral philosophy and a visiting fellow at Oxford. He is known for making ethics feel urgent and alive.
